description: Changing the rules FRIDAY is governed by needs your approval every single time, and a standing permission can never cover it.
Giving FRIDAY standing permission is a bigger decision than the action it covers, so it is approved on its own.
Adding or replacing the credentials for a connected service needs your approval every time. Whoever holds them holds that account.
Changing how FRIDAY herself is configured needs your approval every time.
FRIDAY changing her own code or configuration needs your approval, on a computer rather than a phone, with the full change shown.
FRIDAY does not move money. Not with your approval, not with a standing permission, not ever. Reconsidering this needs a written decision and a security review, not a rule change.
